<!-- GENERATED by scripts/compile-contracts.mjs from contracts/rules. Edit the rule files, then run npm run contracts:compile. -->

- **invariant** `blocks/every-editing-surface-routes-keyframe-changes`: Every editing surface routes keyframe changes through `animEdit`'s pure mutators - `setKeyframe`, `deleteKeyframe`, `moveLayerKeyframes`, `deleteLayerKeyframes`, `moveKeyframe`, `setKeyframeEase`, `setStepEase`, `setLayerActivation` - and then `spliceAnimData` plus one `applyTemplate` makes the edit real, undoable code.
- **rule** `blocks/copies-keyframes-but-never-lands-after`: `duplicateStep` copies keyframes but NOT `reveals` or `hides` and never lands after Out; `deleteStep` returns the layers it revealed to appearing with Play under the channel's default motion; `addStep` makes an empty content step just before Out, or at an explicit index clamped between the entrance and Out. `setLayerActivation` carries a layer's tuned reveal keyframes when it moves between presses and writes the channel's default motion when it enters or leaves the press world, emptied presses disappearing and default step names renumbering.
- **rule** `blocks/steps-clips-preserve-mode-keeps-keyframe`: Steps are CLIPS: `resizeStep` in 'preserve' mode keeps keyframe timing - extending leaves settled air, shrinking clamps at the last keyframe so motion never silently truncates - and 'stretch' (Alt) scales times proportionally. `setLayerHide` is the early-exit twin, writing or clearing a step's `hides` for a layer, clamped after its activation and cleared when hiding at Out, driven by the timeline block's RIGHT edge.
